import numpy as np

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, OrdinalEncoder
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline, make_pipeline
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, KFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score

g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
y = g["churned"]
X = pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"]), dtype=int).fillna({"avg_check": 0})
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
train = X_train.copy()
train["churned"] = y_train
kf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)


train=X_train.copy();train['churned']=y_train
left=train[train.churned==1];extra=left.sample(n=int((train.churned==0).sum()-len(left)),replace=True,random_state=0)
train_up=pd.concat([train,extra])
model=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=50,random_state=0)
f1_wrong=round(cross_val_score(model,train_up.drop(columns='churned'),train_up.churned,cv=kf,scoring='f1').mean(),3)
ss=[]
for tr,va in kf.split(X_train):
 a=train.iloc[tr];left=a[a.churned==1];extra=left.sample(n=int((a.churned==0).sum()-len(left)),replace=True,random_state=0);a=pd.concat([a,extra])
 model.fit(a.drop(columns='churned'),a.churned);ss.append(f1_score(y_train.iloc[va],model.predict(X_train.iloc[va])))
f1_right=round(np.mean(ss),3)
expect: Ожидаю принятие: вычисления следуют формулам и указанному разбиению.
